title: The gym
task: Timed mixed drills over the whole course: 10 questions, 3 minutes, misses become flashcards.

title: Coin change, properly
task: Write minCoins(coins, amount) → the fewest coins summing to amount (or -1). Must survive amount=800 — naive recursion times out by design.

title: Graph playground
task: Free exploration: run any unit 4–5 algorithm on any graph you draw. Share configurations by link.

title: Build a hash table
task: Write createTable(buckets) returning {set, get, has, remove} built on an array of bucket chains — no Map/Object storage.

title: Shortest path in a maze
task: Write findPath(maze) returning the optimal path as an array of "x,y" cell keys from start to goal, using the unit-4 maze model.

title: Implement a sort
task: Write mySort(arr) returning a new sorted array (non-decreasing). Any algorithm counts — the harness reports the complexity yours exhibits.
